import socket, time, re
from collections import Counter
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock')
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r1 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')
eip1 = re.search(r'EIP=([0-9a-f]+)', r1)
time.sleep(1)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r2 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')

hlt = 'HLT=1' in r1

print(f"Progressing: {eip1 and eip2 and eip1.group(1) != eip2.group(1)}, HLT: {hlt}")
s.sendall(b'screendump /tmp/qemu-screen13.ppm\n')
time.sleep(0.5)
s.recv(4096)
s.close()

python3 -c "
from collections import Counter
with open('/tmp/qemu-screen13.ppm','rb') as f:
    f.readline(); dims = f.readline().strip(); f.readline(); data = f.read()
    w, h = map(int, dims.split())
    pixels = [(data[i], data[i+1], data[i+2]) for i in range(0, len(data), 3)]
    non_black = sum(1 for r, g, b in pixels if r > 30 or g > 30 or b > 30)
    color_counts = Counter(pixels)
    print(f'Dimensions: {w}x{h}, Non-black: {non_black} ({100*non_black/len(pixels):.1f}%)')
    print('Top 5 colors:')
    for color, count in color_counts.most_common(5):
        print(f'  RGB{color}: {count} ({100*count/len(pixels):.1f}%)')
"
